description: The list n ↦ floor(n/2) is surjective onto ℕ but not injective. Each k occurs at 2k and 2k + 1, its first-occurrence index is 2k, and retaining first occurrences gives the identity list.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FiniteAndCountableSets.repeated_naturals_list :
  (Function.Surjective fun n => n / 2) ∧
    (¬Function.Injective fun n => n / 2) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ), 2 * n / 2 = n ∧ (2 * n + 1) / 2 = n) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.dedupIndex (fun k => k / 2) n = 2 * n) ∧
          (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.dedup fun n => n / 2) = id
